milestones.title: Gate 1 - demo app runs (Nov 11)
milestones.description: Official ExecuTorch Llama Android demo runs on a real phone; repo, CI and content schema ready.

milestones.title: Gate 2 - streaming chat on phone (Nov 14)
milestones.description: Our INT4 Llama 3.2 1B streams tokens inside our own app; first benchmark numbers exist.

milestones.title: Gate 3 - adaptive loop end to end (Nov 17)
milestones.description: Intake, diagnostic, roadmap, a wrong answer and an adapted plan work end to end, offline.

milestones.title: Gate 4 - feature status review (Nov 19)
milestones.description: Every innovation feature is marked Shipped, Prototype or Cut; beta testers have the APK.

milestones.title: Gate 5 - feature freeze (Nov 21)
milestones.description: Feature freeze. From here only bug fixes, benchmarks, video and report.

milestones.title: Submit - Nov 22 (deadline Nov 23)
milestones.description: Repo, APK, demo video and technical report submitted through the organisers' form.

issues.title: Run the official ExecuTorch Llama Android demo on a real phone
acceptance: Demo app installs and generates text on the team test phone
Phone model, RAM, Android version and exact steps are recorded in docs/setup-runtime.md
Any blocker is emailed to tech-queries@armbharatchallenge.com the same day (subject starts with PS4)

issues.title: Accept the Llama licence; record licences and credits
acceptance: Model access is confirmed
LICENSES/ lists the Llama licence notice, and every library or dataset is added as it is introduced

issues.title: Export Llama 3.2 1B Instruct to INT4 .pte with a reproducible script
acceptance: export/ script builds the .pte from a clean checkout and documents the exact quantization recipe
SHA-256 is recorded in releases/CHECKSUMS.txt; the model file is NOT committed to Git
Model answers a fixed 20-prompt set on the phone

issues.title: JNI wrapper: load, streaming generate, stop, unload
acceptance: Tokens reach Kotlin through a Flow as they are generated
Stop halts generation within 500 ms
No memory growth over 200 consecutive generations

issues.title: Model manager: lazy load, warm-up, low-memory handling
acceptance: App survives a simulated onTrimMemory without crashing and reloads the model on next use
Warm-up generation runs at app start so the first user request is fast

issues.title: Benchmark harness v1: time to first token, tokens/sec, RAM
acceptance: One command or screen reports median and p95 over 10 runs
First numbers are committed under bench/ with the phone model and conditions

issues.title: Prompt templates and JSON schemas for every LLM task
acceptance: content/prompts/ has a template and schema for goal parsing, plan narration, concept explanation, hint, question drafting, teach-back grading and syllabus compilation
System prompt is under 300 tokens and identical across tasks
Each template has two examples; Hindi and English variants exist

issues.title: Orchestrator: validate output, retry twice, fall back to templates
acceptance: Output is checked against the task schema and validator
Up to two retries append the exact validation error to the prompt
After that a deterministic template or simpler question is used; the learner never sees a parse error
Validity rate per task is logged for the report

issues.title: Grounded explanations with analogy and language parameters (I5)
acceptance: Explanation uses the skill's reference note looked up by skill id
Interest-based analogy toggle works; output language switches between Hindi and English
Output includes one check question

issues.title: Hint generation without answer leakage (I1, LLM side)
acceptance: Hint levels 0 and 1 never contain the correct option text (automated test)
Levels escalate: nudge, hint, worked step, solution

issues.title: Teach-back grading: rubric prompt and validator (I7)
acceptance: Scores for accuracy, completeness, clarity and example are in range 0 to 3; feedback is mandatory
At least 70% agreement with a human grader on 40 sample explanations (measured in A17)

issues.title: Syllabus compiler: OCR text to skill graph draft with validator (I4)
acceptance: Graph must be acyclic and have at most 60 skills; invalid graphs are rejected
At least 80% of topics captured on 5 real syllabi
OCR text is treated as data inside delimiters, never as instructions

issues.title: Thermal, battery and memory governor with four modes (I2)
acceptance: Reads thermal status, battery level, charging state and free memory every few seconds
Modes Full, Balanced, Saver, Pause change generation limits and thread count
Every mode change is logged with a reason and visible in the debug panel

issues.title: Sustained 20-minute thermal test with and without the governor
acceptance: Chart of tokens/sec over time with governor on and off
Governor keeps tokens/sec within 25% of peak, or the shortfall is reported honestly

issues.title: Energy-per-token and battery-per-session measurement protocol
acceptance: Method, starting charge, brightness and uncertainty are written down
Results for 1B INT4 are in bench/; a USB power meter is used if one is available

issues.title: LLM evaluation harness: JSON validity, rubric scoring, base vs tuned
acceptance: 500 fixed prompts per task; validity rate before and after retry reported
Scripts for the two-reviewer explanation rubric and the Hindi review sample
One command reproduces the LLM numbers in the report

issues.title: Prompt prefix or KV-cache reuse experiment (X4)
acceptance: Ask mentors whether the ExecuTorch Android runner supports prefix reuse
Report time to first token with and without the optimisation, or document why it is not possible

issues.title: Offline LoRA fine-tune for tutoring tone and JSON discipline (X5)
acceptance: Reviewed, licensed training data in Hindi and English
Adapter merged, quantized and exported to ExecuTorch
Evaluation compares tuned vs base; the base model ships if tuned is not better

issues.title: Model checksums and release asset (no model in Git)
acceptance: SHA-256 of every shipped model is verified at load
Model file is attached to a GitHub release or documented transfer method

issues.title: Repo skeleton: Gradle modules (app, engine), CI, formatting
acceptance: app and engine are separate Gradle modules; engine has no Android dependency
CI runs unit tests and scripts/ci_checks.py on every push

issues.title: Release manifest without INTERNET permission, enforced in CI (B4)
acceptance: AndroidManifest.xml declares no INTERNET permission
scripts/ci_checks.py fails the build if the permission appears

issues.title: Compose app shell: navigation, theme, string resources
acceptance: Screens in section 13.1 exist as navigable stubs
All user-facing text comes from string resources

issues.title: Room database schema and repositories
acceptance: Entities match the PRD data model: Skill, Question, LearnerProfile, SkillState, MisconceptionState, Attempt, Plan, PlanItem, Session, TeachBack
Attempt rows are the single source of truth and can be replayed
Learner snapshot export and import as JSON

issues.title: Intake chat UI with quick-reply chips (C1)
acceptance: Collects goal, level, hours per week, deadline, interests and language
Produces a valid LearnerProfile; free-text goals fall back to chips if parsing fails

issues.title: Streaming tutor chat UI with stop button (C6)
acceptance: First token on screen within 3 seconds on the test phone
Visible stop button; answers cite the current skill and can show the source note

issues.title: Diagnostic quiz UI with confidence slider and hint ladder button (C3, I1)
acceptance: Confidence slider 0 to 100 before each answer; hint button escalates the ladder
Each attempt stores confidence, response time and hint level

issues.title: Roadmap screen with reasons and 'why this' sheet
acceptance: Weekly cards show learn, practice, revise and repair items
Every plan change shows one sentence on why it changed

issues.title: Today and study/practice screens
acceptance: One clear next action with estimated minutes
Streamed explanation, analogy toggle, and check question

issues.title: Dashboard: mastery heatmap, forecast to goal, calibration chart (C7)
acceptance: Updates within 1 second of finishing a quiz; works in portrait and landscape
Lists active misconceptions

issues.title: Recover screen: before/after plan and dropped items (I6)
acceptance: Shows what was dropped and why; never exceeds declared weekly hours

issues.title: Camera OCR scan for syllabus and textbook page (I4, I8)
acceptance: On-device OCR preview with edit-before-generate
Works in airplane mode; scan-to-quiz under 60 seconds on the main phone

issues.title: Device and energy screen; settings with data export and delete
acceptance: Shows governor mode, tokens/sec and battery cost
One tap deletes all data; JSON export works

issues.title: Thread sweep and INT8 / Llama 3.2 3B comparison runs on device
acceptance: Best thread count identified for decode
1B INT4 vs 1B INT8 vs 3B INT4 table with speed, RAM and a fixed quality task set

issues.title: Beta programme: distribute APK, collect the device table, Hindi review
acceptance: At least 8 distinct Arm phones benchmarked and listed in bench/devices.md
Volunteers test and review only; they do not write code

issues.title: Debug APK build for testers and daily integration build
acceptance: Installable debug APK produced by CI on every push to main

issues.title: QR plan export/import and teacher class heatmap (X3)
acceptance: Full roadmap round-trips through QR without data loss
Teacher phone merges 5 simulated students into a heatmap

issues.title: Offline voice: speech to text and text to speech prototype (X2)
acceptance: Works in airplane mode on at least 3 test phones, otherwise marked Prototype

issues.title: UI localisation: Hindi and English complete, UI strings for 4 more languages
acceptance: Language can be switched at any time without losing state
Tamil, Telugu, Bengali and Marathi UI strings present; LLM output in those is labelled experimental

issues.title: Accessibility pass: TalkBack, large text, contrast
acceptance: TalkBack labels on all controls; large-text and high-contrast themes verified

issues.title: Release build, signing, APK on GitHub releases, clean-install test
acceptance: APK installs on a fresh phone and passes the airplane-mode test
Release tag and backup APK link exist

issues.title: Demo video: script, recording, captions in English and Hindi
acceptance: 4 to 5 minute video following the PRD demo path, airplane mode visible
Uploaded and linked from the README

issues.title: Choose two domains; skill graph schema and validator (C2)
acceptance: Two domains are named (suggested: DSA for placements and ML engineering) with a subject reviewer each
JSON schema and validator: acyclic graph, difficulty 1 to 5, estimated hours, reference notes

issues.title: Skill graph content for domain 1 (at least 35 skills)
acceptance: Prerequisites, difficulty, hours, resources and reference notes (150 to 300 tokens) per skill
Passes the validator in CI

issues.title: Skill graph content for domain 2 (at least 35 skills)
acceptance: Same quality bar as domain 1; passes the validator in CI

issues.title: Misconception-tagged question bank for domain 1 (at least 6 per skill)
acceptance: Every wrong option maps to a misconception id; exactly one correct option; distractors unique
Reviewed by the subject reviewer or faculty mentor

issues.title: Misconception-tagged question bank for domain 2
acceptance: Same quality bar as domain 1

issues.title: Knowledge tracing with forgetting curve and unit tests (C4)
acceptance: Implements the BKT update and exponential retention exactly as in the PRD
Unit tests match reference equations; mastery stays within 0 to 1
Revision is scheduled when effective mastery falls below 0.7

issues.title: Misconception engine: evidence, repair items, resolution
acceptance: Confidence-weighted evidence; two confident hits create a repair item before dependent skills
Resolved after three correct answers spaced over at least two days

issues.title: Adaptive diagnostic question selection
acceptance: 10 to 15 questions; placement quality checked in the simulator
Ends within 12 minutes on average

issues.title: Planner and re-planner (C5)
acceptance: 100% prerequisite-valid roadmaps across 1,000 simulated learners
Replan under 1 second excluding LLM text; every Plan carries a reason string

issues.title: Hint ladder and confidence calibration logic (I1)
acceptance: Bias and Brier score tracked; overconfident and underconfident labels trigger the PRD behaviours
Hint level weights 1.0, 0.7, 0.4, 0 applied to mastery updates

issues.title: Missed-day recovery with knapsack replanning (I6)
acceptance: Prerequisite closure is preserved; dropped items are listed with reasons

issues.title: Learner simulator with 8 learner types (I3)
acceptance: Fast, average, slow, forgetful, overconfident, anxious, irregular and misconception-prone learners
Runs headless on a laptop using the same engine module; fixed random seeds

issues.title: Simulator baselines and ablations
acceptance: Fixed roadmap, topic-only, no-forgetting, LLM-only and random-order baselines
Ablations remove one feature at a time

issues.title: Cognitive-load-aware pacing (X1)
acceptance: Fatigue index from response time and error streak; always dismissible

issues.title: Run simulator experiments and produce report tables and charts
acceptance: At least 1,000 learners per type with confidence intervals
One command reproduces every simulator number in the report

issues.title: Technical report: draft, figures, results, limitations
acceptance: Follows the 13-section outline in the PRD, including the Shipped / Prototype / Designed status table
Benchmarks are compared with the mentors' reference numbers; limitations are stated honestly

issues.title: Content and report review with the faculty mentor
acceptance: Question bank sample, skill graphs and the report are reviewed and sign-off notes saved in docs/
